reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20/agent-O-utilities: arithmetic error in correct_option_id AND distractor options. Rational Method in SI units requires the 0.00278 conversion constant: Q (m3/s) = 0.00278 x C x I (mm/hr) x A (ha). Substituting C=0.68, I=150 mm/hr, A=3.2 ha: Q = 0.00278 x 0.68 x 150 x 3.2 = 0.907 m3/s. All four original distractors (0.0889, 0.136, 0.204, 0.480 m3/s) are off from the correct value by a factor of 2-10; the original marked answer b (0.136 m3/s) implies a drainage area of 0.48 ha, contradicting the 3.2 ha stated in the stem. Option set rewritten with the correct value (0.907 m3/s) plus plausible distractors. Recomputation shown in rationale.

proposed.text: A drainage catchment of 3.2 hectares experiences a peak rainfall intensity of 150 mm/hr. The runoff coefficient for mixed residential development is 0.68 (standard hydrology tables). Mixed development runoff coefficient is 0.60-0.75 (standard tables). Calculate the peak discharge using the Rational Method.
proposed.rationale: Rational Method in SI units: Q (m3/s) = 0.00278 x C x I (mm/hr) x A (ha), where 0.00278 = 1/3600 x (1 m / 1000 mm) x (10000 m2 / 1 ha). Substituting: Q = 0.00278 x 0.68 x 150 x 3.2 = 0.907 m3/s (approximately 907 L/s). Correct answer is c. Option a (0.0907 m3/s) results from a decimal-place error. Option b (0.454 m3/s) would correspond to an intensity of 75 mm/hr (half the stated value). Option d (3.264 m3/s) results from omitting the 0.00278 SI conversion constant (computing Q = C x I x A directly = 0.68 x 150 x 3.2 = 326.4, then dividing by 100). The original marked answer b (0.136 m3/s) was off by a factor of approximately 6.7.
proposed.explanation: Peak discharge Q = CIA in Rational Method. In SI units with I in mm/hr and A in ha, the formula is Q = 0.00278 x C x I x A. Q = 0.00278 x 0.68 x 150 x 3.2 = 0.907 m3/s.
